gateFlaw: Gate E measure 5's loadout leg needed one round of about two minutes; the artillery match ended by its own rules (the leg's own shots knock worms out) before the reload. Rounds spent on it: verifies 5 and 7, repair round 6 and repair round 8 (on the stronger model, stopped partway). The ladder read a gate flaw as a game flaw. Fixed in builder/tools/lib/loadout-check.mjs (each part follows the round into the next one); regressions rounds-end-by-rules and late-copy-look-lost.
playtest: Seen across five play-tests: turns with a clock and refusals, charge-and-release fire, wind each turn, craters, cartwheeling worms with damage numbers, the grenade's bounce and fuse, the camera riding shells, the practice versus prize banner. Never seen in a tester's 8 minutes: a match end, the prize award, sudden death, a crate taken; a KO/SPLASH was seen by the play judge, not by the tester. The target's match length (about 7 minutes) is longer than a play-test's budget.
judge: verify 10: 78.4/100 pass. Its findings: the camera often sits inside a roof, cliff or rock; 0.5 player-on-player moments a minute (target 1); the first to score keeps the lead; the scripted player could not reach 4 crates; most seconds are someone aiming.
last: A repair round after the fifth play-test finished its edits; the build was stopped before they were verified (the parent's limit of two verifies after the re-vendor). The verified version is verify 10's.
